### Arithmetic supported and unresolved

Posted exact-export shards 4800+5100+4900+5200+5000+4700+5300+5000 = 40000 GB-month. Cancelled ALDER-SHARD-VOID 2500 excluded; May/June/July slices and charges excluded from current correction. Prior current-source correction total is 0. Let B be the missing authoritative Backup GB entitlement, d its missing portfolio fraction, r its missing standard rate. Compute allocation A = round_half_up(max(40000-B,0),6). Local review L = round_half_up(max(A × .048 × (1-d),0),2). Compute EU West and Backup US East differ, so remote R = round_half_up(A × r,2). Final target L+R; upward delta = round_half_up(max(L+R-500,0),2), with no posting if target ≤500. No compute primary, campaign, commitment or local discount applies to the remote component. The final A,L,R and posting amount cannot be uniquely derived. A displayed “25 TB” tier label is not itself the formally requested numeric entitlement schedule and supplies neither d nor r.

### Problem tree and missing evidence

Root upward correction → approved incorrect shared-snapshot review (doc 76: “Before the shared snapshot upward correction is handled, the exact source must have an approved incorrect shared-snapshot arithmetic review.”). find_compute_events returns no such review for the source. Review → completed compute-attributable capacity allocation (doc 88: “Before the shared snapshot arithmetic review is handled, its exact source must have a completed compute-attributable capacity allocation.”). The query returns only a raw export/packet and posted meters, with no allocation; this gate is unmet. Allocation uses existing source-correlated packet plus exact export, so physical delivery is not missing. However its required B is absent. Doc 68 says “read backup plan entitlement in GB from the unique same-entity active backup holding”; finder returns tier identity only. Doc 86 requires Backup portfolio fraction and doc 82 requires its standard rate. All three values lack a numerical home in the supplied 432-document corpus (Compute, Storage, Support only). Runtime grep request in 1_requests_3 returns referring Compute/Storage clauses but no Backup tier values. Absence is established from the full supplied corpus, not ranking/top-k.

The visible execution path is agent allocate_compute_snapshot_3bc9aa3a(A, original packet/source/export) → agent review_compute_snapshot_6efd32f0(L, allocation receipt as evidence and related reference) → agent debit_compute_snapshot_133263fe(delta, review receipt as evidence and related reference). All three interfaces were actually unlocked and match these linkages. No numerical business tool was called using an assumed B,d,r. Terminal state remains unchanged pending authoritative commercial terms; intended terminal is one compute-managed corrected snapshot source without a separate Backup/remote financial line or further settlement.

Including the cancelled 2500 conflicts with “Cancelled snapshot quantities ... are excluded.” Subtracting entitlement per slice conflicts with “Allocate the backup entitlement once against the total physical GB-month subtotal.” Applying a Compute portfolio discount or discounting the remote component conflicts with the local-subtotal and combined-amount clauses. Refusing because the invoice was already paid has no support in the visible scope. Numerical alternatives for B,d,r cannot be excluded from the supplied material; hence unique calculation and completion are blocked. No omitted source value has been filled in from author knowledge.
